summary: The United States struck Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, prompting Iran's IRGC to threaten US bases and claim capture of a US unmanned submarine near the Strait of Hormuz. Simultaneously, Israel conducted strikes in Gaza City and Khan Younis, while European nations moved to restrict trade with Israeli settlements. Yemen's anti-Houthi fronts have activated across multiple provinces in a coordinated escalation.
key_points: The US carried out strikes on Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, Iran, with Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya HQ threatening to severely target US bases and interests in the region in response (Source: @presstv/205978).

Multiple explosions were heard near the anchorage area of Iran's Kharg Island and also on Qeshm Island in Bushehr Province, with no official confirmation of cause or damage (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6936).

The IRGC Navy claimed to have captured a US Navy autonomous underwater vehicle (Dive-LD) near the Strait of Hormuz, describing it as the most advanced unmanned submarine in the US fleet (Source: @presstv/205949).

The Israeli Air Force struck Hamas infrastructure in Khan Younis and targeted a terror operative in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, wounding several Palestinians (Source: @manniefabian/59122).

Eleven European countries and Canada announced restrictions or planned restrictions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, calling on Israel to halt settlement expansion (Source: @yediotnews25/134821).
UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband announced new sanctions on Hezbollah's financial arm, in addition to existing sanctions on the IRGC (Source: @New_security8200/203693).

Anti-Houthi forces activated across multiple fronts in Yemen including Jawf, northeast Sanaa, Marib, Al-Bayda, Al-Dhale, Taiz, and Hodeidah, with Saudi and UAE-backed forces participating (Source: @mamlekate/104377).
The US Treasury sanctioned 36 companies and individuals linked to Iran's aviation sector, including 27 airlines, as part of an economic enforcement operation (Source: @VahidOnline/78277).

sections.executive_summary: The United States has struck Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, marking a direct military escalation between Washington and Tehran. Iran's IRGC has responded with threats against US regional bases and claims of capturing a US unmanned submarine near the Strait of Hormuz. Concurrently, Israel has conducted strikes in Gaza City and Khan Younis, while a coordinated anti-Houthi offensive has activated across multiple Yemeni fronts.
iran: Multiple explosions were heard near the anchorage area of Kharg Island, Bushehr Province, with reports also of blasts on Qeshm Island. No official Iranian statement on cause, origin, or damage has been released as of the latest reports (Source: @sharghdaily/182644).

The US carried out strikes on Iranian oil tankers at the direction of President Trump, according to an official who spoke to Faytuks Network. Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters responded by threatening to severely target US bases and interests in the region if aggression against Iranian ships continues (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6940).

The IRGC Navy claimed to have captured a US Navy Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicle near the Strait of Hormuz, describing it as one of the newest unmanned systems in the US Navy fleet designed for long-endurance crewless missions (Source: @presstv/205949).

Iranian users are currently experiencing intentional internet speed throttling, according to reports from Tehran. The cause and scope of the throttling have not been officially confirmed (Source: @shin_persian/9590).

The US Treasury sanctioned 36 companies and individuals connected to Iran's aviation sector, including 27 active airlines and intermediary firms, as part of what was described as an economic enforcement operation (Source: @VahidOnline/78277).

Iran's IRGC spokesperson addressed the US directly, stating that advanced unmanned submarine technology cannot penetrate Iranian surveillance layers in the Strait of Hormuz, and told the US to return to the Persian Gulf (Source: @sharghdaily/182649).
Iranian state media reported explosions in the port city of Jask on the coast of the Gulf of Oman, though details on cause and damage remain unconfirmed (Source: @asafroz/53226).
israel: The Israeli Air Force struck Hamas infrastructure sites in southern Gaza and targeted a terror operative in Gaza City, according to the IDF. Palestinian media reported several wounded in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood strike and in Khan Younis (Source: @manniefabian/59122).

An Israeli strike was reported in the Al-Nasr street area near Sheikh Radwan cemetery and the Dar Al-Quran complex in northern Gaza, carried out based on intelligence information (Source: @yediotnews25/134815).

UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband announced sanctions on Hezbollah's financial arm during a speech in the British Parliament, while emphasizing Israel's right to exist and noting existing sanctions on the IRGC (Source: @New_security8200/203693).

Eleven European countries including Britain, France, Germany, and Canada announced national or EU-level restrictions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, calling on Israel to immediately halt settlement expansion (Source: @yediotnews25/134821).

Israel's Foreign Ministry is reportedly preparing a response to countries that have declared boycotts on settlements, with discussions at the Kiryat Gat military headquarters about expelling representatives from boycotting nations including Britain and France (Source: @New_security8200/203695).

Netanyahu announced his Likud party's ranked candidates for the Knesset list, including positions for Talik Guihuli and Yaakov Bardugo, amid ongoing political negotiations (Source: @yediotnews25/134817).

The UAE Foreign Ministry denied reacting to media reports about conversations between UAE and Israeli leaders, stating the UAE's involvement since October 7 has consistently aimed at de-escalation and regional stability (Source: @almogboker78/18151).
gaza_west_bank: The IDF conducted a targeted strike in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood near Al-Nasr street, the Sheikh Radwan cemetery, and the Dar Al-Quran complex in northern Gaza, wounding several people according to Palestinian media (Source: @manniefabian/59122).

Strikes were also carried out in southern Gaza's Khan Younis, wounding several Palestinians according to Palestinian media reports. The IDF stated it would provide further details later (Source: @manniefabian/59122).
The strikes were reportedly conducted based on intelligence information, according to initial reports from Gaza (Source: @yediotnews25/134815).

Eleven European countries and Canada announced restrictions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, specifically calling on the Israeli government to halt settlement expansion and hold settlers accountable for violence (Source: @yediotnews25/134821).

Reports indicate that 12 countries including Britain, Canada, and France plan to impose sanctions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank in response to increased settler violence against Palestinian villages (Source: @mamlekate/104388).
lebanon: UK Foreign Secretary David Miliband announced sanctions on Hezbollah's financial arm during a parliamentary address, building on previously imposed sanctions against the IRGC (Source: @New_security8200/203693).

The UAE Foreign Ministry stated that the UAE's involvement since October 7 has consistently aimed at de-escalation and regional stability, and that government and Israeli officials have maintained open direct communication lines for over five years (Source: @almogboker78/18151).
syria_iraq: Anti-Houthi forces have activated across multiple fronts in Yemen simultaneously, including the Jawf and northeast Sanaa, where forces moved toward Houthi positions in the Labnata area. The Marib front saw Houthi positions under aerial bombardment (Source: @mamlekate/104377).

The Al-Bayda and Al-Dhale fronts in central and southern Yemen have reactivated, with Houthi command positions targeted by strikes. The Taiz front has been one of the primary battlefields in recent days with anti-Houthi forces advancing in some areas (Source: @mamlekate/104377).

The Hodeidah and western coast front is considered critical as it approaches Mocha and ultimately Bab al-Mandeb, with intense clashes reported. Forces involved include the Yemeni army, local tribes, National Resistance forces backed by the UAE, and forces led by Tariq Saleh (Source: @mamlekate/104377).
A Houthi field commander named Manaa al-Ghuli was eliminated during fighting with government forces in Taiz, according to reports (Source: @shin_persian/9578).
The Yemeni government's state media reported that a decision has been made to liberate Sanaa and that efforts are underway, according to the deputy minister of defense (Source: @mamlekate/104377).

Saudi Arabia has been identified as the primary backer of the Yemeni government, while the UAE maintains a network of forces it previously supported. Saudi Arabia has been accused by the Houthis of involvement in recent airstrikes, though Riyadh has not officially confirmed (Source: @mamlekate/104377).
gulf_states: Shin Bet-related reports indicated that the danger in Najran, Saudi Arabia, has passed as of 1707Z (Source: @shin_persian/9576).
US Navy P-8 maritime patrol aircraft and fuel tankers were observed operating in the Strait of Hormuz, according to reports (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80545).

The UAE Foreign Ministry denied reacting to media speculation about conversations between UAE and Israeli leaders, emphasizing that UAE-Israel communication channels have remained open since the normalization of relations over five years ago (Source: @almogboker78/18151).

Reports indicate that the UAE previously warned Netanyahu about a Hamas attack 10 days before October 7, though the UAE office denied the report. Critics have called for accountability (Source: @mamlekate/104388).
key_developments: The US struck Iranian oil tankers near Kharg Island, prompting Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya HQ to threaten US bases across the region. The IRGC Navy simultaneously claimed capture of a US unmanned submarine near the Strait of Hormuz, representing a major escalation in US-Iran tensions (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6940).

Multiple explosions were reported near Kharg Island anchorage and on Qeshm Island in Bushehr Province, Iran, with no official confirmation of cause or damage. The incidents occurred amid heightened US-Iran military activity in the Persian Gulf (Source: @sharghdaily/182644).

The IDF struck Hamas targets in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood and in Khan Younis, wounding several Palestinians. The strikes were conducted based on intelligence and targeted both infrastructure and operatives (Source: @manniefabian/59122).

Anti-Houthi forces activated across at least six simultaneous fronts in Yemen including Jawf, Sanaa, Marib, Al-Bayda, Al-Dhale, Taiz, and Hodeidah, involving Yemeni army units, UAE-backed National Resistance forces, and Saudi-backed factions (Source: @mamlekate/104377).

Eleven European countries and Canada announced restrictions on trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank, calling on Israel to halt settlement expansion and hold settlers accountable for violence against Palestinians (Source: @yediotnews25/134821).

The US Treasury sanctioned 36 entities and individuals linked to Iran's aviation sector, including 27 airlines, as part of an economic enforcement operation targeting Iran's military aviation capabilities (Source: @VahidOnline/78277).

UK Foreign Secretary Miliband announced sanctions on Hezbollah's financial arm in Parliament, adding to existing sanctions on the IRGC, signaling expanded Western financial pressure on Iran's proxy network (Source: @New_security8200/203693).
sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous US strikes on Iranian oil tankers and Iran's retaliatory threats represent the most significant direct military confrontation between Washington and Tehran in recent months. Iran's claim of capturing a US unmanned submarine near the Strait of Hormuz, if verified, would constitute a major intelligence and operational breach. The activation of multiple anti-Houthi fronts in Yemen suggests a coordinated ground offensive targeting Houthi supply lines toward Bab al-Mandeb. Combined with European settlement restrictions and expanded sanctions on Iran's aviation and Hezbollah financial networks, the regional security environment is deteriorating rapidly with multiple escalation vectors operating simultaneously.
sections.regional_response: European powers have collectively moved to restrict trade with Israeli settlements, with 11 countries plus Canada announcing national-level restrictions, signaling growing diplomatic isolation for Israel's settlement policies. The UK has expanded sanctions to Hezbollah's financial arm, tightening the economic noose on Iran's proxy network. Saudi Arabia continues to back Yemeni government forces while facing Houthi accusations of involvement in airstrikes, which Riyadh has not confirmed. The UAE maintains its de-escalation posture publicly while its backed forces remain active on Yemeni battlefields. Iran has responded to US aggression with both military threats and information warfare, including internet throttling domestically.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of US strikes on Iranian tankers, IRGC claims of US submarine capture, and simultaneous explosions on Kharg and Qeshm islands suggests a coordinated campaign of strikes and counter-strikes in the Persian Gulf. The activation of six anti-Houthi fronts simultaneously in Yemen indicates a planned, multi-axis offensive rather than opportunistic clashes. The US Treasury's sanctions on 27 Iranian airlines target Iran's military logistics and mobility capabilities. The UAE's denial of prior warnings to Netanyahu about October 7, combined with continued communication channels with Israel, suggests ongoing intelligence-sharing relationships despite public diplomatic friction. Iran's domestic internet throttling during this period of external military tension may indicate concerns about internal unrest or information control.
